source.title: Aramark Sports + Entertainment Kicks Off 2026 NFL Season Across Eight NFL Stadiums

notes: Official Aramark 2026 release with sourced sections. CBS listed additional local vendors; those without Aramark/team section confirmation were not imported. Mile High Favs $5 staples excluded.

items.name: Beast in a Blanket
items.description: Official 2026 shareable: 2-foot grilled hot dog and brisket burnt ends wrapped in puff pastry with cheddar, goat cheese, secret sauce, avocado cream, crispy pickled onions, and jalapeño.

items.name: Chicken & Champagne Bucket
items.description: Official 2026 12-piece fried chicken with two cans of champagne in a souvenir bucket. 21+ with valid ID.

items.name: Nine in the Box
items.description: Official 2026 stack of nine wagyu sliders with sharp white cheddar, caramelized onions, steak tomato, and tangy burger sauce on brioche.

excluded.name: Mile High Favs $5 staples
excluded.reason: Hot dogs, nachos, pretzels, popcorn, candy, soda, water.

excluded.name: Aloha Cones / Carrera's / Cupbop / Mister Oso SKUs
